items.title: P1: rewrite voter-visible unsure notes; move internal reasoning to editorNote
engineeringInstructions: For each row: set `summary` = new at every sourcePath (data/civic/positions_gapfill_*.json) and at stancesPath (data/stances.json), or update the source files and re-run scripts/merge_gapfill.py.

At each sourcePath also add `editorNote` = the old summary of that item. Never render editorNote, and never copy it into data/stances.json (bundled into the client). merge_gapfill.py currently copies only score/quote/summary/sourceUrl/date/voteRecord/bill, so it is excluded already; keep it that way.

Civic's own file is already updated: copy /workspace/townhall/civic/positions_gapfill_batch3civic.json over data/civic/positions_gapfill_batch3civic.json (backup at civic/positions_gapfill_batch3civic.pre_qa7.json). It also adds allison-bush unsure education with override:true so Engineering's hand edit survives a re-run.
Rendered text is `{issue}: unclear, not compared. {summary} {source}`; the quote is not shown, so each summary stands alone. 'Not scored' was dropped because the label already says 'not compared'.
Simulated in /tmp (copy of the repo, all rows applied, merge_gapfill.py re-run): every rendered summary matches `new`, no editorNote in stances.json, unsure count 35.
